At Regent Seven Seas Cruises®, Nobody Does It Better™, especially when it comes to partnerships. Our mission is to empower you, our valued Travel Advisors, with cutting-edge insights, unrivaled support and revenue-enhancing opportunities. Regent is dedicated to elevating your expertise, ensuring you thrive in an ever-evolving travel landscape while delivering exceptional value to your clients. Elevate your business by selling the best value in all-inclusive ultra luxury travel, and enjoy our incredible guest return rate, unrivaled commissions and generous perks. LEARN MORE Quick Links: Travel Partner Selling Guide Upselling Guide - Premium to Luxury Immediate Confirmation Rates Suite Advantage Upgrade Regent Connect Update Your Profile My Bookings Make a New Booking Make a New Booking To make a new reservation, select a cruise below. You may use any of the drop down menus to filter the list of cruises. After selecting a cruise, you may either get a Quick Quote which you may send to yourself and/or your clients, or begin the booking process.
